Uploadcare — upload and REST

uploadcare/api · version 1

envs add uploadcare/api

This declares the keys below in your catalog and sets none of them. A template is a schema for keys; it never carries a value.

Key Needed Kind Notes
UPLOADCARE_PUBLIC_KEY required config Uploadcare's widget runs this key in the browser to upload, which is the direction that makes it public.. where to get it
UPLOADCARE_SECRET_KEY required secret REST key. Reads and deletes, so it stays server-side.. where to get it
